versions.content: Upon request by the Dcm , the Dem shall respond with the data available for a particular OBDMID / TIDindex per requested OBDMID using the API Dem_DcmGetDTRData . This value can be used by the Dcm to iteratively request for the DTR data per OBDMID / TIDindex starting from 0 to numberofTIDs minus one.
